title: Website Product Manager (m/f/d)
description:
ABOUT US
Pliant is a modular B2B payments platform that combines commercial card issuing, payment accounts, FX, and spend management in one system — adapting to existing setups rather than requiring customers to replace them.
Businesses across industries such as travel, e-commerce, and insurance use Pliant to manage complex payment workflows with cards, backed by credit lines Pliant underwrites itself.
Fintechs and software platforms embed Pliant's payment infrastructure into their own products, from API-based Cards-as-a-Service to fully white-label solutions. Banks use Pliant's Card & Spend OS, the customer-facing interface, on their own infrastructure to run card programs.
Founded in 2020 and headquartered in Berlin, Pliant serves 5,000+ businesses and 40+ partners across Europe and the United States. A principal member of Visa and Mastercard, Pliant issues commercial cards in 13 currencies across 32 countries — under its own European e-money license and with licensed partners in the UK and US.
Learn more at http://www.getpliant.com/www.getpliant.com http://www.getpliant.com
ABOUT THE ROLE
As our Website Product Manager (m/f/d) you will own the website as a product. You will also take ownership of the strategy, roadmap, and prioritization across content, performance, and events requests, with hands-on technical execution and close collaboration across Marketing, Design and Engineering to keep page performance improving.
This role will be in based in Berlin (hybrid).
WHAT YOU’LL DO
 - Own website strategy, roadmap, prioritization (content/performance/events)
 - Competitive review, and development of own “website vision”
 - Review requests/tickets at intake, incl. rough technical feasibility
 - Hands-on: Storyblok components, new pages/templates, basic HTML/CSS
 - Technical SEO setup (meta tags, structured data, sitemaps, Core Web Vitals)
 - GTM/GA4 tag management (tags, triggers, variables, conversion tracking)
 - Conversion-aware: understands funnel/landing page best practices
 - Close collaboration with Content, Design, PMM, Engineering (data layer, CI/CD, infra-level SEO) on page performance
WHAT YOU’LL BRING
 - Hands-on experience with Storyblok or a similar headless CMS, including building, updating, and publishing pages
 - Technical web literacy to troubleshoot simple issues and brief developers clearly. HTML/CSS knowledge and familiarity with GitHub is a strong plus
 - Strong project management skills to coordinate content, design, and performance teams
 - Ability to prioritize website improvements based on user needs and business impact
 - Experience with analytics, conversion optimization, and A/B testing — owning the overall testing framework/roadmap across teams (performance, content, etc.)
 - Working knowledge of technical SEO, accessibility, and website quality assurance
 - Demonstrated ownership mentality - commits to deadlines, proactively flags risks, and takes constructive feedback well
 - Comfortable scoping technical requests and communicating clearly with engineering on what’s feasible and when
WHAT WE OFFER 
 - The opportunity to work in a growing team with big responsibilities that thrives on a strong exchange of knowledge and excellence
 - Attractive remuneration
 - Your choice of preferred OS, Windows or Mac
 - Flat hierarchy and transparent communication in a relaxed, professional atmosphere
 - Opportunity to develop your talent in a dynamic team with ambitious goals
 - Flexibility and possibility to work remotely
 - Monthly mobility benefit
 - Wellhub Membership
 - Pliant Card with monthly credit to explore the product and enjoy food with colleagues
Pliant is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and abilities, and are committed to an inclusive hiring process. If you need any accommodations during the interview process, please let us know.
At Pliant we use the Ashby AI Criteria to assist with looking over resumes against our job qualifications for this role. All final decisions are made by our Talent Team and Hiring Team.
A human is behind these processes. Ashby does not automatically reject candidates or make final hiring decisions. Our teams review all results and make the final hiring decision with every candidate that applies.

title: Technical Program Manager, Customer Experience
description:
ABOUT PLEO
Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.
The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.
Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.
ABOUT THE ROLE
We're looking for a Technical Program Manager, Customer Experience at Pleo. In this role, you'll help lead complex technical programs at the intersection of Customer Experience, Customer Success, Support, Onboarding, Product, Engineering, Data, Revenue Operations and AI. You’ll help turn Pleo’s CX transformation strategy into scalable technical capabilities that make it easier for customers to onboard, get support, realise value, resolve issues and grow with Pleo.
This is not a traditional project-management role focused on timelines, meetings and status updates. You’ll understand the customer and business problem, get into the technical details, translate requirements between CX and Engineering, challenge proposed solutions, manage technical dependencies, and drive programs from concept through implementation, adoption and measurable impact.
WHO YOU’LL BE WORKING WITH AND REPORTING TO 
You’ll report to our Director, CX and work closely with teams in Customer Success, Support, Onboarding, Digital Content and Self-Service, Voice of the Customer, and Revenue Operations. Our team is highly collaborative and dedicated to acting as a technical bridge between CX and Pleo’s Product, Engineering, Data and systems organisations. You’ll also have the chance to partner with teams across Product, Engineering, Data and Analytics, Finance, Risk and Fraud, and Business Systems to ensure success and keep technical decisions tied to customer outcomes and business value.
WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING
As a Technical Program Manager, you will: 
 - Lead CX technology programs end-to-end, from problem definition and requirements through design, testing, launch, adoption and optimisation. Own scope, milestones, dependencies, risks and decisions, and confirm after launch that the technology changed adoption, customer impact and operations.
 - Partner with CX leadership to define the technical roadmap for the customer experience transformation, and help establish the future-state CX technology architecture for Pleo’s next stage of growth.
 - Translate customer and business problems into clear technical requirements and acceptance criteria for Product, Engineering, Data and systems teams, and explain architecture, trade-offs, risks and options to CX leaders in business language.
 - Drive integration programs connecting CRM, Customer Success, Support, Onboarding, Product, billing, analytics and AI platforms. Document customer data flows: where data originates, where it moves, which system owns it and how it is used.
 - Support a single customer view and improve customer health and risk infrastructure, combining usage, support, onboarding, payment, engagement and sentiment signals. Partner with Data on churn prediction, proactive risk detection and next-best-action.
 - Drive AI-enabled CX programs for self-service, agent productivity, onboarding, Customer Success, knowledge retrieval, QA and virtual customer-facing capabilities. Set scope, release criteria and quality gates for the engineers and data scientists building AI agents, without line management of those teams.
 - Automate repetitive CX workflows and reduce technical debt across customer-facing systems. Challenge automation that is covering up a broken process.
 - Lead technical programs with Support (routing, case management, escalations), Customer Success (health, lifecycle triggers, forecasting) and Onboarding (digital journeys, implementation tracking, time-to-value).
 - Own UAT coordination, business readiness and technical program governance for major CX releases, including decision logs, dependency and risk tracking, and architecture decisions. Escalate risks with recommendations, not just status.
 - Make sure CX signals reach Product, so recurring friction and customer needs become visible and actionable.
WHAT YOU BRING 
You’ll thrive in this role if you have:
 - 5+ years of Technical Program Management, leading complex technology programs.
 - Experience in SaaS, fintech, enterprise technology or another high-growth digital environment.
 - Experience managing programs across multiple systems, integrations, APIs, data flows and technical dependencies, where no single team owns the whole solution.
 - A solid grasp of the software development lifecycle, from requirements and architecture through testing, release and optimisation, in Agile or hybrid environments.
 - Program fundamentals: requirements, scope, roadmap, dependency and risk management, technical governance, stakeholder management, UAT, release and change management, and adoption measurement.
 - Strong analytical skills and comfort with operational and customer data.
 - Clear written and verbal communication. You can state the problem, recommendation, trade-offs and decision needed concisely, and translate technical decisions into language senior

description:

We are Edenspiekermann - an independent design consultancy with 40+ years of experience helping world-leading organizations invent, build, and evolve their products. Our Product Strategy practice works directly with product teams at the intersection of market insight, design excellence, and AI-driven development.
Our interaction designers work in agile and interdisciplinary teams on websites and platforms for major brands as well as for startups. Our teams combine conceptual thinking, a sophisticated understanding of design and a deep knowledge of web and app development to develop a digital product or service with a user-centric approach. In doing so, we advise and coach our clients' teams to provide the best customer experience for their customers.
**About the Role**
Great design needs more than great ideas. It needs clear plans, the right resources, someone who makes sure everything comes together, and our work actually ships. As a Project Manager at Edenspiekermann, you manage projects across product and brand strategy, product design and brand design – from kick-off to final delivery.
Your focus is on efficient, commercially sound project delivery: planning work, coordinating teams, managing budgets and keeping implementation on track. You work closely with our Design Directors, who typically lead strategic and creative conversations with clients. Together, you make sure client requirements translate into clear scopes, realistic plans and successful outcomes.
Some of our projects involve complex technology and substantial development work. You’re comfortable working closely with developers and understand how design and technology come together.

* Managing projects across product and brand strategy, product design and brand design, from scoping to delivery

* Identifying risks, dependencies and scope changes early, and coordinating solutions with the team and client
* Coordinating day-to-day client communication on schedules, budgets, deliverables and feedback, in close partnership with our Design Directors
* Organising briefings, workshops, reviews and handovers to keep decisions and implementation moving
* Supporting pitches and proposals with estimates, resource plans and delivery schedules
###### **Your profile**
* 2–5 years of project management experience in a design, digital or branding agency
* Experience planning and controlling project budgets, schedules and resources across several projects in parallel
* A solid understanding of strategy and design processes across brands and digital products, and a feel for design quality

* A structured, hands-on way of working, commercial awareness and a cool head when things move fast

* Clear, honest communication with clients and colleagues

title: (Senior) Product Manager,Trust Platform – Modules (f/m/d)
description:
IDnow is a leader in digital identity and fraud prevention in Europe with a mission to transform trust into the most powerful asset in the digital world, empowering enterprises with AI-driven, SaaS-based identity solutions that deliver scalable security, adaptive compliance, and real-time fraud prevention . Through its broad portfolio of digital identity and fraud prevention solutions, IDnow establishes, maintains and enriches trust throughout the customer journey, ensuring businesses can confidently and securely operate while leveraging digital identity to drive growth, security and scalability.
The company has offices in Germany, United Kingdom, Romania and France , and is backed by renowned institutional investors, including Corsair Capital and Seventure Partners. Its portfolio of international clients spans a wide range of end markets including financial services, telecommunications, travel & mobility, gaming, and other industries.
This position is based in Berlin/Munich, Germany.
The Trust Platform team builds the capabilities that bring identity and fraud prevention signals together into configurable customer journeys. It gives customers a consistent way to orchestrate signals, configure decision logic, and access outcomes through APIs and a studio. By connecting IDnow products, external providers, and customer needs, the team turns a broad platform ecosystem into clear, scalable solutions. Its work strengthens IDnow’s ability to help businesses make trusted decisions throughout the customer journey.
As (Senior) Product Manager, Trust Platform – Modules (f/m/d), you own the product direction for platform capabilities that extend the Trust Platform’s orchestration model, studio, APIs, dashboard, and data layer. You work at the intersection of market and commercial functions, customers, vendors, other IDnow product teams, Engineering, Data, Design, and Analytics. This is the most strategic and market-facing product role in the team, with responsibility for anticipating customer needs and translating them into coherent platform capabilities.
 Key Responsibilities
 You are very close to our customers and work closely with Sales, Solutions, Marketing, and other commercial functions to assess market needs, anticipate customer problems, and proactively identify viable use cases 
 Lead the end-to-end integration lifecycle for non-IDnow signals, including biometrics, device fingerprinting, Politically Exposed Persons (PEP) and sanctions screening, document databases, and credit bureaus, across the orchestration model, studio, and application programming interfaces (APIs) 
 Conduct commercial and technical evaluations of vendors and lead requests for proposal (RFP) processes to ensure the Trust Platform offers state-of-the-art tools and capabilities 
 Act as the product counterpart to other IDnow product teams, own the integration of their products into the Trust Platform, and manage cross-functional dependencies 
 Own the dashboards and analytics features within the Trust Platform dashboard, providing customers with meaningful real-time data on conversion, drop-offs, and fraud 
 Design unified data schemas and reusable data blocks so signals from different providers use consistent definitions and speak the same language within the Trust Platform

title: Founders Associate (m/w/d) E-Mobility & Heating
description:
Über uns Rabot Energy ist ein unabhängiger Anbieter dynamischer Stromtarife für Haushalte und Unternehmen. Mit smarten Einkaufsstrategien und automatischer Steuerung verschieben wir flexiblen Verbrauch in Stunden mit niedrigen Börsenpreisen. So optimieren Haushalte und Unternehmen ihre Stromkosten. Unsere Vision ist es, allen Kund:innen die Möglichkeit zu geben, ihren Stromverbrauch smart zu steuern und von günstigen Börsenstunden zu profitieren.
Warum jetzt? Der Energiemarkt erlebt den größten Umbruch seit 50 Jahren. Regulierung wie §14a EnWG und der Smart-Meter-Rollout machen Flexibilität zum Kern des Systems. Unser Produkt funktioniert und hat seinen Product-Market-Fit gefunden. Die Frage ist nicht mehr, ob es funktioniert, sondern wie schnell wir es in den Massenmarkt bringen.
 Das ist eine kommerzielle Aufgabe: schärfere Positionierung, eine Vertriebsmaschine, die skaliert, und Marketing, das aus einem noch erklärungsbedürftigen Produkt eine einfache Entscheidung macht. Genau im Zentrum dieser Aufgabe sitzt diese Rolle.
Deine Mission Als Founders Associate arbeitest du direkt mit unserem Management-Team zusammen und im Tagesgeschäft eng mit dem Lead unserer Business Unit E-Mobility & Heating, dessen kommerziellen Erfolg du vorantreibst. Deine Mission: aus einem Produkt, das bereits funktioniert, kommerziellen Erfolg machen. Du greifst die Themen auf, die gerade am wichtigsten sind, gibst ihnen Struktur und bringst sie über Sales, Marketing und Partnerships zu Ergebnissen.
 Commercial ist dein Fokus, nicht deine Grenze. Wie in jedem Startup denkst du das Geschäft als Ganzes und springst ein, wo du gebraucht wirst, von Product und Operations bis Finance.
Deine Ergebnisse Wir denken in Ergebnissen, nicht in Aufgabenlisten. Wenn du erfolgreich bist, sieht das so aus:
 Monat 3 (Ramp-up) 
 Du verstehst unser Produkt, das E-Mobility- & Heating-Geschäft und die kommerziellen Prioritäten gut genug, um deine ersten Themen eigenständig zu übernehmen.
 Du hast ausgewählte Initiativen übernommen und erste sichtbare Ergebnisse über Sales, Marketing oder Partnerships geliefert.
 Du machst aus Daten erste Analysen und Dashboards (Funnel, Conversion, CAC, CLV), mit denen das Team tatsächlich arbeitet.
 Monat 6 (Performance) 
 Du verantwortest mehrere kommerzielle Prioritäten end-to-end, von der ersten Analyse bis zur Umsetzung.
 Du treibst strategische Partnerschaften von Business Case und Verhandlung bis zum signierten Deal voran, inklusive der Unterlagen, die Partner überzeugen.
 Du unterstützt das Marketing mit schärferer Positionierung und Messaging und hilfst, Kampagnen und Launches vorzubereiten.
 Deine Analysen und Dashboards sind Grundlage für Management-Entscheidungen, inklusive Board- und Investor-Unterlagen.
 Monat 12 (Scale) 
 Du bist eine verlässliche treibende Kraft unserer Commercial-Agenda, und deine Arbeit zeigt sich in Sales- und Wachstumszahlen.
 Du verbindest Sales, Marketing, Product und Operations, sodass alle in dieselbe Richtung ziehen, und bleibst dran, bis die Dinge erledigt sind.
 Du übernimmst zunehmend größere und strategischere Initiativen eigenständig.
 Wen wir suchen Analytischer Kopf: Du strukturierst komplexe Probleme schnell, arbeitest sicher mit Zahlen und kennst dich mit Excel, Google Sheets und BI-Tools aus.
 Kommerzielles Gespür: Du verstehst, wie Kund:innen kaufen, was einen Funnel konvertieren lässt und wie Sales und Marketing zusammenspielen. Gleichzeitig bringst du eine ganzheitliche Business-Perspektive mit und siehst, wie Product, Operations, Finance und Regulierung den kommerziellen Erfolg beeinflussen.
 Klare Kommunikation: Du schreibst prägnante Decks und Dokumente und präsentierst souverän vor Gründer:innen, Partnern und Kund:innen.
 AI-native: Du nutzt AI-Tools wie Claude, ChatGPT oder Lovable als festen Teil deines Arbeitsalltags, um schneller zu werden.
 Bias to ship: Du lieferst lieber heute eine 80-Prozent-Version als in drei Wochen die perfekte, und du bekommst Menschen hinter deine Prioritäten, auch ohne formale Autorität.
 Background: 1 bis 3 Jahre Erfahrung in einem schnelllebigen Umfeld, idealerweise in einem Scale-up, in Consulting, Investment oder einer kommerziellen Rolle wie Sales, Business Development oder Growth. Interesse an der Energiewende; Vorwissen zum Energiemarkt ist ein Plus, kein Muss.
 Sprache: Deutsch auf C1-Niveau mit sicherem Schreibstil sowie fließendes Englisch.
 Was wir Dir bieten Nähe zur Leadership: Du arbeitest täglich Hand in Hand mit dem Management-Team und dem Business-Unit-Lead und siehst, wie Entscheidungen getroffen werden.
 Echter Impact: Deine Arbeit zeigt sich in Sales- und Wachstumszahlen, nicht in der Schublade.
 Steile Lernkurve: Sales, Marketing, Strategie und Finance in einer Rolle, mit einem klaren Weg in eine Führungsposition.
 Kurze Wege: Was du heute entscheidest, kann morgen live sein.
 AI-first-Tooling: die Tools, die du willst, und die Freiheit, sie im Arbeitsalltag zu nutzen.
 Kultur: Neue Ideen sind willkommen, Lernen zählt, und das Leben darf dazwischenkommen.

 For more than 25 years we have taken on some of the hardest digital challenges governments and enterprises face. Great software delivery is not project plans and status reports. Today that means delivering with AI at the center of how we work, not at the edge of it.
AI is changing software development, and we are looking for a Senior Project Manager who wants to lead that change rather than wait it out. Someone who leads experienced international teams, works close to the customer, and already delivers AI-first.
 Who You Are
 You work with people as much as you work on projects. You stay steady under pressure, communicate with confidence, and earn trust without performing it. You coach, you delegate, and you build teams that hold together.
You are self-driven and always learning. When you don't know something, you find out. When something breaks, you and your team fix it. You don't wait to be taught what you need to succeed.
 What You'll Do
 Lead complex software projects from first scope to delivery, working with the customer and a multidisciplinary team the whole way. In practice that means:
You lead distributed international development and testing teams, and you know how to motivate them across time zones and borders. You build trusted relationships with customers and act as their delivery partner, negotiating scope and change requests on equal footing and holding our commercial interests when it gets tense. You plan and steer with both classical and agile methods, and you know when each one fits. You own budget, schedule, risk, dependencies, and project profitability. When the load gets too high, you prioritize, delegate, and ask for help rather than go quiet.
You don't need to write code, but you understand engineering well enough to hold a real technical conversation and to know how a business application gets built from scratch.
 What We're Looking For
 You run recurring project work AI-first and make the method reusable, so the capability belongs not just to you but also to your team. You understand AI-first SDLC: how to initiate and run a project AI-first, how to move a team from traditional to AI-first delivery, and how the roles around you shift as that happens. You handle customer-side AI constraints with judgment — public versus sensitive data, on-premise versus cloud, and what to do when a customer says no AI at all — and you can explain calmly how our licensed tools sit alongside their policies and the law.
You have extensive experience leading software development projects. A track record leading distributed international teams. You enjoy working directly with customers and building relationships that last. You like numbers and make decisions from them, because at Nortal numbers are a daily habit, not a quarterly event. Your written communication is precise, reliable, and professional.
You negotiate and communicate with confidence in German (C1). You are comfortable working in English every day and happy to use it. You are ready to travel occasionally for customer meetings and team gatherings.
 Nice to have
 Hands-on experience with AI-first frameworks in real project work. We know that deep hands-on track records in this are still rare. The understanding is non-negotiable and you should be able to show it convincingly. Demonstrable curiosity counts for more than years of practice.
Experience delivering fixed-price projects and knowing what that means for your own P&L. Experience in the public sector. A history of managing risk and staying composed in a crisis. Experience responding to public tenders or proposals. A higher PM certification such as PMP, or an AI-first / AI-in-PM qualification.
 About Nortal
 We work at national and enterprise scale, across technology, business, and the public sector, on the kind of engagements, where getting it wrong is not an option. That is the work, and it is why customers keep the hard problems for us. You would join colleagues who take the work seriously and each other's success personally.
Our process usually starts with an intro call, followed by capability interviews. We will walk you through it when we connect.
If this is your kind of work, apply today.

 Job Summary
 The Product Operations Manager plays a critical role in ensuring the seamless execution and continuous improvement of product development and delivery processes within the Product Management team. Reporting to the Sr. Director of Product Management, this strategic and hands-on position is instrumental in optimizing SUFS product operations, collaborating cross-functionally to deliver high quality solutions that align with our organization's goals and stakeholder expectations. The Product Operations Manager will drive process optimization, strategic planning, product planning and product delivery / status management to achieve operational excellence.
 Location : Remote (United States)
 Key Responsibilities
 Act as a liaison between Product Managers and various departments to ensure effective communication and alignment throughout the product development lifecycle. 
 Coordinate and facilitate regular product development meetings to review progress, address roadblocks, and prioritize tasks. 
 Create and maintain roadmaps and delivery plans for product development initiatives, outlining tasks, timelines, and dependencies. 
 Lead the coordination and execution of product launches, collaborating with marketing, sales, and customer support teams to ensure a seamless release. 
 Establish and maintain a release calendar to manage product updates, hot-fixes, and new feature releases. 
 Conduct post-launch evaluations and gather feedback to drive continuous improvement in the launch and release process. 
 Foster effective communication and collaboration among different teams involved in product development and operations. 
 Collaborate with customer support to ensure a smooth transition from development to support phases. 
 Drive quarterly product planning process between Product and IT teams. 
 Identify inefficiencies and bottlenecks in product development processes and propose actionable solutions to enhance productivity and quality. 
 Implement and maintain standardized workflows and documentation to streamline product operations. 
 Utilize data-driven insights to make informed decisions and guide product development strategies. 
 Prepare regular reports on key performance indicators (KPIs) related to product operations and identify areas for improvement. 
 Monitor and track progress against product milestones, identifying risks and proposing mitigation strategies as needed. 
 Identify and assess potential risks related to product development and implement measures to mitigate those risks. 
 Develop contingency plans to address unexpected challenges that may arise during product development. 
 The above is not an all-inclusive list of all duties performed by this job title, only a representative summary of the primary duties and responsibilities.
 Qualifications
 Requires a bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience. 
 Minimum of three years’ product operations experience. 
 Must be articulate, a good listener and possess the ability to persuade teams to work to their highest potential. 
 Excellent verbal and written communication skills. 
 Accurate and precise attention to detail. 
 Able to build strong interpersonal relationships. 
 Proven record of delivery and project successes in previous positions.
 Demonstrated success and a proven track record in professional/life experience in specific job functions, projects, or industries. Military service can substitute for professional experience and/or formal education requirements. 
 You’ll Stand Out If You Have
 PMP and Agile certifications are valued, but not required.
 Key Competencies
 Prior experience as a Product Owner, ScrumMaster or Agile Coach with experience on agile teams with proven record of delivery and product successes in previous positions. 
 In-depth understanding of Agile methodologies, technical understanding of products, and up-to date on industry standards and best practices. 
 Technical background with knowledge of software development and web technologies.
 Comfortable working with multiple teams, in-house and remote; strong team player.
 Ability to remain agile through change and exercise strong decision-making capabilities with limited or incomplete information. 
 Must pay close attention to detail, ask probing questions, investigate and research possibly solutions to problems. 
 Ability to work independently and take charge without much involvement from others. Strong communication, interview, and facilitation skills. 
 Problem-solving (root cause analysis) and conflict resolution skills.
